baseline.holdoutRule: The v1-v8 holdouts were promoted to regression after evaluation. A draft v9 run exposed and corrected a mislabeled v5 regression case, then stopped before the candidate reached either new holdout. The two v10 holdouts were selected, truth-labelled and frozen before the regression-driven final candidate revision; every development run was stopped before reaching them, and they must not be used to revise that candidate.

invariants: Only containers carrying the BCRS Deposit Mark are eligible for a refund.
The refund is S$0.10 per eligible container.
Containers without the mark remain recyclable through blue bins or other recycling stations.
